summary: A cable manager for the same rack keyholes as the adaptor holder. A 20 x 53 x 4 plate carries the two teardrop rack pins (z 7 and 45) and, centred on each pin, a cable loop 40 wide and 14 tall: a rounded U strap lid (2.4 wall, R6 outside) over a 35.2 x 12 cable space, hinged along the cable on a 3-knuckle hinge with 45 deg cone pins (printed in place, like the reference) and closed by a bead-and-hook click latch taken from seba-med-cap. Printed upright as used: the lower loop stands on the bed, the upper lid needs support under it only. A 12 x 18 window saves material. PLA, one per plate.

assumptions: A1: one loop centred on each rack pin (user).
A2: loop 40 wide (user), 14 tall (user rev 6); cable space depth = reference + 2 mm (user).
A3: rev 6 (user): print in place, upright; support only under the upper lid (it stands on the lower lid). Rev 5 drop-on lids broke while fitting (user).
A4: hinge tighter (user): cone clearance 0.25; the lid has about 0.35 axial play before the cones take it.

A5: rev 7 latch after seba-med-cap (user): 45/45 bead on the post, 45/45 hook on a 1.0 arm; rev 8 bead 0.75 (user: raise it); rev 9 bead 1.05, 0.75 travel (user: tighter by 0.3; arm strain about 4.6 %, test it); no preload, because the lid prints closed and the hook must print 0.3 clear of the bead.
